dataClassification.preservation: Passages are rebuilt only from canonical entities in the pinned SnapshotReader. The private cache keys vectors by entity, sentence index, text hash and pinned model revision, and stores separate memberships for each repository snapshot. It contains derived project text and vectors, is not in Git, and is invalidated/rebuilt when deleted or stale.

dataClassification.target: recomputed rule and embedding candidates for the selected snapshot
dataClassification.preservation: Candidate records are regenerated from canonical snapshot entities and the selected snapshot's semantic index; no generated candidate table is treated as an author decision. Results carry source evidence and remain snapshot-bound.

P04 maps the source file byte-for-byte when semantic is enabled and preserves it in the module legacy namespace when disabled. The semantic reactivation producer restores those bytes only when the canonical target is absent; a divergent target is reported as a conflict and is not overwritten. Dismissal actions propose revision-guarded updates through Core.

dataClassification.source: new author choice: semantic reranker preference
dataClassification.preservation: The read/update actions expose the reranker preference and pinned model identities. Updates are settings ChangeOperations with the observed revision and proposal evidence; the UI routes them to author review.

Embedding and reranker artifacts remain outside the repository. The worker loads the pinned Xenova/multilingual-e5-small revision and the source BGE reranker revision on demand; it does not send project content to an external inference provider. Artifacts may be fetched if absent.

implementedBehavior: A lazy semantic.embedding capability provides supervised worker indexing, nearest search over a pinned snapshot, shared E5 embeddings for consumers, contradiction-pair scoring, status, and reranking. The worker is created only on a capability lease and disposed with its final lease.

Snapshot-pinned corpus indexing and reusable local vectors; source passage segmentation and E5 passage prefix; hybrid lexical/vector search with source known-term expansion, field weighting, short-token fallback and reciprocal-rank fusion; scene, sentence and expression modes.
Optional pinned BGE cross-encoder reranking on CPU, bounded to the top 30 candidates, with source-style RRF-order fallback and a visible warning when the model is unavailable.

Source string/reading term clustering and opt-in embedding-only edges; source scene-state ownership/location rules and mid-band mention-pair candidates; current dismissal filtering and author dismissal proposals guarded by actual Bible and plot snapshot scopes.

Public semantic index/search/expression/term-cluster/contradiction/settings/task actions and dock/review/settings browser contributions, including progress, cancellation, privacy text, provider-safe search limits, visible reranker warnings and author-proposed reranker settings.
